title: Mesh-Only Guard - Prevent Dual Renderer Execution
description: Successfully implemented exclusive mesh/point-sprite rendering guard to eliminate split renderer artifacts

technical_summary.problem: Both mesh shader and point-sprite renderers were executing simultaneously, causing split visual artifacts where half the particles appeared as flat plane (point sprites) and half as proper triangles (mesh shader)
technical_summary.root_cause: No guard logic to prevent point-sprite rendering when mesh shader mode is active, leading to dual execution in non-volumetric rendering path
technical_summary.solution: Added m_forceMeshOnly flag and conditional skip logic to enforce exclusive rendering

core_changes: Added m_forceMeshOnly boolean flag to Application.h (default: true)
Modified recordCommandBuffer to conditionally skip point-sprite rendering when mesh-only mode active
Added debug logging to confirm mesh-only mode activation
Added Z key toggle for runtime debugging of dual renderer issues
Added debug assertions to catch point-sprite execution in mesh mode

exclusive_rendering.issue: Both renderers executing in else branch of volumetric check
exclusive_rendering.fix: Added else if (!m_forceMeshOnly) guard around point-sprite rendering
exclusive_rendering.result: Point sprites only render when explicitly allowed, preventing dual execution

state_logging.issue: No visibility into which renderer path was active
state_logging.fix: Added static logging 'CR 1031: Mesh-only mode: enabled' on first mesh render
state_logging.result: Clear confirmation of exclusive mesh rendering activation

runtime_toggle.issue: No way to test different renderer combinations during debugging
runtime_toggle.fix: Added Z key toggle to enable/disable mesh-only mode at runtime
runtime_toggle.result: Runtime debugging capability for renderer comparison

before.split_artifact: PRESENT - half particles as flat plane, half as mesh shader triangles

after.split_artifact: ELIMINATED - only mesh shader rendering active
after.rendering_mode: Exclusive mesh shader execution confirmed by logs
after.app_stability: Runs multiple frames, shell extraction completing successfully
after.mesh_only_logging: CR 1031: Mesh-only mode: enabled - confirmed in output

Application.h.new_flag: bool m_forceMeshOnly = true; // CR 1031: Force mesh-only mode to prevent dual rendering artifacts

Application.cpp.render_guard: Added else if (!m_forceMeshOnly) condition around m_particleSystem->render()
Application.cpp.debug_logging: Static logging of mesh-only mode activation
Application.cpp.toggle_key: Z key toggle for m_forceMeshOnly with status logging

debug_output_added: CR 1031: Mesh-only mode ENABLED/DISABLED (prevents point-sprite rendering when mesh shaders active)

testing.environment: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti, Windows WSL2
testing.test_scenario: Stellar Formation preset with mesh shader default mode
testing.before_behavior: Immediate crash after split artifacts visible
testing.after_behavior: Multiple frames executed, shell extraction successful, exclusive mesh rendering confirmed
